mapping.external_idea: Directly model ordered finishing dependence instead of relying only on independent winner probabilities.
mapping.conclusion: Do not reinvent PL. Keep C0 PL as control, C1 line-aware utility+PL, and N1 conditional rank-2/rank-3 chain as the clean architecture ladder.

mapping.external_idea: Treat line formation/order as a structured sequence/graph-like object.
mapping.conclusion: Primary implementation remains low-DOF explicit relations first (line_group, line_position, line_size, singleton, same_line, ahead/behind). Graph neural networks are deferred until simple relational terms fail or clearly underfit with adequate data.
Market should be baseline, not opponent. Future odds inputs require a frozen pre-decision timestamp and transport semantics. Current ODDS boundary remains BLOCKED.

mapping.external_idea: Remove takeout / infer market-implied probability and detect model-vs-market edge.
mapping.conclusion: Use coherent market baseline/residual comparison only after point-in-time market data is authorized. Edge thresholds must be frozen before settlement/outcome evaluation.
Preserve chronological/blocked evaluation, burned-outcome firewall, and untouched final holdouts.

mapping.external_idea: Expected-value ticket selection and Kelly sizing.
mapping.conclusion: First prove probability quality and flat/fixed-risk edge. Kelly or adaptive sizing is later-stage only after untouched validation; do not use bankroll sizing to rescue a weak probability model.
